limitations: Source classes are same-agent sparse-frame reviews, not exhaustive physical throw labels.
Temporal links do not prove a stone is the same physical object across cameras.
Targeted relaxed raw paths, when present, were searched only near existing left-only events.
Coverage gaps and unobserved throws remain unknown.
No row is promoted to a complete board or simulation-ready state.
Post-candidate cap samples are partial right-camera pixels, not a complete settled board.
An intervening missed delivery or player handling can contaminate the sampled window.
Before/after changes are cap visibility differences, not verified stone movements or scoring states.
Terminal credits are excluded from routed support; no event, board or spin claim changed.
